mapper.insert: INSERT INTO novel_event (novel_id, title, summary, characters, chapter_no, order_in_chapter, created_at) VALUES (#{novelId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{characters}, #{chapterNo}, #{orderInChapter}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM novel_event WHERE novel_id = #{novelId} ORDER BY chapter_no, order_in_chapter
SELECT * FROM novel_event WHERE novel_id = #{novelId} AND characters ILIKE #{characterName} ORDER BY chapter_no, order_in_chapter
